findings.text: blocking: this test and three siblings (tests/test_impl_stays_authorable_while_records_are_partial.py:107, tests/test_bookkeeping_earns_no_review.py:254, tests/test_plan_review_store.py:298) assert the authored impl stands for a partially recorded plan, the behaviour this change supersedes; all four fail at head (confirmed by re-running them), so the done_when clause that the reckon._plan_html-importing tests pass is not met.

follow-on: derive_impl_with_source annotates its return as a bare tuple rather than tuple[float | None, str | None], so the pairing of figure and source is unchecked by the surrounding typed signatures.
